description: This file implements TLS-specific AEAD cipher operations, including initialization, cleanup, sealing, and opening functions for various cipher and hash combinations used in TLS, with support for CBC mode and explicit IV handling.

classes.name: AEAD_TLS_CTX
classes.description: Context structure holding cipher and HMAC states, MAC key, key length, and IV implicit flag for TLS AEAD operations.

methods.name: aead_tls_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up cipher and HMAC contexts within AEAD_TLS_CTX.

methods.name: aead_tls_init
methods.description: Initializes the AEAD context with key material, cipher, hash, and IV settings for TLS.

methods.name: aead_tls_tag_len
methods.description: Calculates the tag length for TLS AEAD, considering CBC mode and padding.

methods.name: aead_tls_seal_scatter
methods.description: Performs encryption and MAC computation for TLS, producing ciphertext and tag.

methods.name: aead_tls_open
methods.description: Performs decryption and MAC verification for TLS, extracting plaintext.

methods.name: aead_aes_128_cbc_sha1_tls_init
methods.description: Initializes AEAD context for AES-128-CBC with SHA-1 in TLS.

methods.name: aead_aes_128_cbc_sha1_tls_implicit_iv_init
methods.description: Initializes AEAD context for AES-128-CBC with SHA-1 in TLS with implicit IV.

methods.name: aead_aes_256_cbc_sha1_tls_init
methods.description: Initializes AEAD context for AES-256-CBC with SHA-1 in TLS.

methods.name: aead_aes_256_cbc_sha1_tls_implicit_iv_init
methods.description: Initializes AEAD context for AES-256-CBC with SHA-1 in TLS with implicit IV.

methods.name: aead_des_ede3_cbc_sha1_tls_init
methods.description: Initializes AEAD context for 3DES-CBC with SHA-1 in TLS.

methods.name: aead_des_ede3_cbc_sha1_tls_implicit_iv_init
methods.description: Initializes AEAD context for 3DES-CBC with SHA-1 in TLS with implicit IV.

methods.name: aead_tls_get_iv
methods.description: Retrieves the IV used in the AEAD context if applicable.
